scope: Synchronous CPU float64 tensor literals and elementwise arithmetic; float64 tensor worker modules, reductions/matmul and Metal remain gated.

implementation.reuse: Existing backend tensor types/loops, strict binary64 scalar arithmetic, eight-byte storage/size checks, checked invocation ABI and ownership machinery are unchanged. New frontend admission enables synchronous float64 tensors; shared numeric capability checks guard unsupported operations and task modules.
implementation.arithmetic: Tensor/tensor and either scalar operand order for +,-,*,/; unary signs; separately rounded a*b+a. IEEE division by zero, signed zeros, subnormals, infinities and canonical arithmetic NaNs. Unary plus and sign-bit negation preserve their specified exact bits.
implementation.literals: Rank zero, nested vector/matrix data, flat explicit higher-rank shapes, empty vectors/matrices, float alias, direct binary64 literals, min subnormal/max finite values; finite overflow remains S015.
implementation.limits: Eight-byte count boundary and product/negative shape checks before reads/allocations; shape mismatch/refinement and allocation failures publish no partial result. Borrowed inputs remain immutable. Retained backing remains readable after invocation settlement.
implementation.gates: S053 rejects float64 reduceSum/matmul. S054 rejects any module combining float64 tensor metadata with task operations or TaskError functions, including unused declarations, until tensor layouts are qualified. Backend checks independently reject forged typed IR. Metal rejects float64 and unsupported operations preserve destination artifacts.

qualification.reference: Shared Float64Oracle.h LLVM APFloat IEEEdouble corpus. Full ranked sweeps use 467411 pairs; scalar-lift runs choose one scalar per batch and compute corresponding lane references; rank zero samples 4096 positions spanning the corpus.
qualification.floating_environments: Four ARM rounding modes with FZ/DN disabled/enabled (8); literal/refinement sweeps included, installed controls checked, no FP flags, host state restored.
qualification.ownership_checks: Every successful lane is checked twice: before and after Invocation::settle while a retained AllocationLease keeps backing alive. Counts below include both checks; they are not distinct random inputs.
qualification.views: Padded noncontiguous borrowed input views with aligned-pointer and offset displacement; distinct-valued non-square 2x3 transposed versus normal strides; aliased inputs and every empty axis.
qualification.failures: Static literal overflow and eight-byte extent bounds; dynamic mismatch/refinement, negative and oversized dimensions, exact byte bound with injected allocator failure, intermediate allocation rejection, and poll-triggered cancellation with sender-ready handshake/retry only on an early completed workload.

regression.final_tensor_reason: Strengthened the transpose/alias probe to use distinct-valued non-square matrices; implementation unchanged after the broader conformance run.

performance: Not measured. Integer binary64 lowering is a correctness path; host sanitizers do not instrument Metal shaders.
